claims: Maintain lung-protective mechanical ventilation with low tidal volume and PEEP, and consider weaning assessment as sedation lightens and spontaneous breathing is present.
Monitor sedation depth and titrate sedatives to target RASS -1 to -2, reassessing frequently to avoid oversedation.
Monitor for alcohol withdrawal using CIWA-Ar and treat symptoms with lorazepam as needed.
Continue levetiracetam and monitor phenytoin level; consider rechecking phenytoin level if seizure prophylaxis is indicated.
Monitor blood glucose and administer sliding-scale insulin as ordered for glucose >100 mg/dL.
Replete electrolytes as needed, including potassium and magnesium, and monitor levels.
Perform oral care and subglottal suctioning to reduce ventilator-associated pneumonia risk.
Provide VTE prophylaxis with mechanical compression devices or pharmacologic prophylaxis as appropriate.
Mobilize patient and provide range-of-motion exercises as tolerated to prevent deconditioning.
Assess and manage pain with opioid analgesia as needed, monitoring response.
